sentences.zh: 以下是总统昨天晚些时候在接受路透社采访时，谈到华为首席财务官孟晚舟时所说的话。

sentences.en: He said,
sentences.zh: 他说，

sentences.en: Well, you know, if I strike a really good trade deal with Xi Jinping, the Chinese president, maybe we'll just release Ms. Meng.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，如果我和中国国家主席习近平达成一笔非常好的贸易协议，也许我们就会释放孟女士。

sentences.en: China and the United States are engaged in the last stages of this enormously complex set of trade talks that President Trump has escalated.
sentences.zh: 中国和美国正处于特朗普总统不断升级的这轮极其复杂的贸易谈判的最后阶段。

sentences.en: If I think it's good for the country, if I think it's good for what will be certainly the largest
sentences.zh: 如果我认为这对国家有利，如果我认为这对肯定是有史以来最大的

sentences.zh: 所以总统在那里……

sentences.zh: 所以他突然把司法部所描述的法律程序，与习近平可能成为贸易谈判中的一枚棋子混为一谈。

sentences.en: So there are many in the administration who were not happy to hear the president say that.
sentences.zh: 因此，政府中许多人听到总统这样说很不高兴。

sentences.en: And you have to imagine that the Chinese side will see that as another poker chip on the bargaining
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，中方会把这看作是谈判桌上的

sentences.en: table here as they sort of hash out what kind of a deal they can come to by March 1St.
sentences.zh: 又一个筹码，因为他们正在敲定3月1日之前究竟能达成什么样协议。

sentences.en: Their concern is that President Trump will take the easy political out of getting an agreement
sentences.zh: 他们的担忧是，特朗普总统会为了政治上的轻松退路，

sentences.en: from the Chinese to buy hundreds of billions of dollars in American goods, and that as the price for that, he'll ignore these longer term issues surrounding Huawei.
sentences.zh: 同中方达成购买数千亿美元美国商品的协议，而作为代价，他会忽视这些围绕华为的长期问题。

sentences.en: Now, this hasn't happened yet, and maybe it won't happen.
sentences.zh: 现在，这还没有发生，也许也不会发生。

sentences.en: We don't know because it's all in the black box of the China negotiations right now.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道，因为这一切目前都处于中美谈判的黑箱之中。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But I have to imagine that national security officials, if the president were to pursue this
sentences.zh: 但我不得不想象，如果总统要推行这种

sentences.en: kind of deal, would tell him that what he would be giving up is far greater than what he would be getting in return.
sentences.zh: 协议，国家安全官员会告诉他，他所放弃的将远大于他所得到的。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Well, David, you have been covering cybersecurity for a really long time.
sentences.zh: 大卫，你报道网络安全已经有很长时间了。

sentences.en: Do you believe that the level of threat here that national security officials believe exists with Huawei is as significant as they believe it is?
sentences.zh: 你认为国家安全官员所认为的华为威胁程度，真的像他们所认为的那样重大吗？

sentences.en: You know, Michael, I believe there is a potential threat for the diversion of data because all
sentences.zh: 你知道，迈克尔，我认为存在数据被转移的潜在威胁，因为所有

sentences.en: countries do this, and countries want to go dominate the telecommunications lanes for the same
sentences.zh: 国家都会这么做，国家都想主导电信通道，这与

sentences.en: reason that in a previous era, the British wanted to dominate sea lanes, and then we wanted to
sentences.zh: 前一个时代英国想要主导海上通道的原因一样，接着是我们想要

sentences.en: dominate sea lanes, and then we came to dominate air power, and then the competition over who would dominate space.
sentences.zh: 主导海上通道，然后我们开始主导空中力量，再到对谁能主导太空的竞争。

sentences.en: So you have to think of the internet as just another domain in which this battle is being fought out.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须把互联网看作是这场战斗正在进行的又一个领域。

sentences.en: But, you know, it's got the hints of a larger problem that I don't think we've been debating in the course of this.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，它带有一个更大问题的迹象，我认为我们在讨论过程中一直没有讨论过。

sentences.en: Over the past few years, we've actually seen the internet begin to get balkanized.
sentences.zh: 在过去几年里，我们实际上看到互联网开始走向巴尔干化。

sentences.en: It's getting divided between East and WeSt. We're seeing the Chinese throw out gradually or make life hard for Google, Facebook, other American companies, recently
sentences.zh: 它正在东西方之间分裂。我们看到中国逐渐将谷歌、脸书等美国公司驱逐或使其步履维艰，最近还有

sentences.en: Microsoft, and replace those firms with their Chinese equivalents.
sentences.zh: 微软，并用其中国的同类企业取代这些公司。

sentences.en: Then we saw them begin to spread out with equipment that would not only tie together like-minded countries, but then
sentences.zh: 然后我们看到他们开始部署设备，这些设备不仅能将志同道合的国家串联起来，而且

sentences.en: would lend themselves to the kind of social control that the Chinese have been exercising.
sentences.zh: 还适用于中国一直在施行的那种社会控制。

sentences.en: In Chinese networks, of course, they're now using artificial intelligence and facial recognition to keep track
sentences.zh: 当然，在中国网络中，他们现在正使用人工智能和面部识别来追踪

sentences.en: of dissidents, to make sure that there are social credit scores that can get transmitted around easily to figure out who's a most loyal citizen.
sentences.zh: 异见人士，确保能够轻松传输社会信用评分，以弄清谁是最忠诚的公民。

sentences.en: So the Chinese networks may become the favorite of authoritarians around the world.
sentences.zh: 因此，中国的网络可能会成为全球威权主义者的最爱。

sentences.en: And if that happens, we could end up with a sort of new Berlin wall, but one that is built around these networks.
sentences.zh: 如果发生这种情况，我们最终可能会得到一种新的柏林墙，但这是一堵围绕这些网络建立的墙。

sentences.en: A highly controlled part of the internet that's run by the Chinese, and then a Western internet that's more like what we're all accustomed to.
sentences.zh: 由中国运营的高度控制的互联网部分，以及一个更像我们所习惯的西方互联网。

sentences.en: When you type into the search engine, tell me about Tiananmen Square, you get a real Wikipedia entry that answers it,
sentences.zh: 当你在搜索引擎中输入“告诉我关于天安门广场的信息”时，你会得到一个真正的维基百科词条来回答，

sentences.en: that you wouldn't get if you type those same questions in over a Chinese network.
sentences.zh: 如果你在中国的网络上输入同样的问题，你是不会得到的。

sentences.en: So the fight over Huawei, you're saying, fits into that.
sentences.zh: 所以你是说，围绕华为的争斗就契合了这一点。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: is discouraging kind of our half of the world from letting Huawei in, which may further this division of these two internets, the East and the WeSt. Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 正在阻止我们这半个世界让华为进入，这可能会进一步加剧东西方这两个互联网的分裂。绝对是的。

sentences.en: The Chinese have been trying to do this for a long time, but we may actually be feeding that process by barring Huawei and other Chinese companies from
sentences.zh: 中国长期以来一直试图这样做，但我们通过禁止华为和其他中国公司

sentences.en: building key parts of the Western internet.
sentences.zh: 建设西方互联网的关键部分，可能实际上在助长这一进程。

sentences.en: And, you know, the oddity about this is if you're going to have a global telecommunications network, sooner or later, the United States is going to have to plug
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这其中的奇特之处在于，如果你要建立一个全球电信网络，迟早美国也不得不接入

sentences.en: in to the Huawei built 5G networks as well.
sentences.zh: 由华为建造的5G网络。

sentences.en: Now that's not the same as having them build the core of your own network, but it's not as if you're going to be able to say, we're never going to talk to a
sentences.zh: 这与让他们建造你自己的网络核心不同，但也不是说你能够宣称，我们永远不会和一个

sentences.en: 5G network built by the Chinese.
sentences.zh: 由中国建造的5G网络对话。

sentences.en: I wonder, is there an argument for letting Huawei in a controlled way help develop networks around the world, including in the United States, so that there is a truly
sentences.zh: 我想知道，有没有这样一种论点：以受控的方式允许华为协助开发全球（包括美国在内）的网络，从而实现一个真正

sentences.en: integrated internet?
sentences.zh: 一体化的互联网？

sentences.en: I understand the risks you're outlining and they seem very real, but if everybody goes off into their corner and builds their own internet, that would seem like its own
sentences.zh: 我理解你所概述的风险，它们看起来非常真实，但如果每个人都退守到各自的角落去建立自己的互联网，那本身就会带来

sentences.en: giant set of national security risks.
sentences.zh: 一整套巨大的国家安全风险。

sentences.en: It does seem that way to me.
sentences.zh: 我确实也有同感。

sentences.en: And I think there's one strong argument in favor of letting Huawei compete in some of these Western countries and maybe even compete in the United States.
sentences.zh: 我认为有一个强有力的论点支持允许华为在一些西方国家参与竞争，甚至在美国参与竞争。

sentences.en: It's that if they want to have their equipment and their software inside the United States, they have to show it to American authorities, right?
sentences.zh: 那就是，如果他们想把设备和软件放进美国，他们就必须将其展示给美国当局，对吧？

sentences.en: They have to bring that software over, let the United States poke through it, let it examine it for backdoors.
sentences.zh: 他们必须把软件带过来，让美国对其进行彻查，检查是否存在后门。

sentences.en: And in fact, in private, you've heard many people in U.S.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在私下里，你听到美国

sentences.en: industry say to the National Security Agency, hey, the smart way to go about this is let Huawei compete.
sentences.zh: 工业界的许多人对国家安全局说，嘿，明智的做法是让华为参与竞争。

sentences.en: It'll drive the price down and you'll see their work.
sentences.zh: 这会把价格打下来，而且你们也能看到他们的工作。

sentences.en: And the NSA's answer, at least so far, has been, we're sorry, the risk is just too great.
sentences.zh: 而国安局的回答，至少到目前为止是：很抱歉，风险实在太大了。

sentences.en: David, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 大卫，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate this.
sentences.zh: 我们对此深表感谢。

sentences.en: Great to be with you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能和你在一起，迈克尔。

sentences.en: from Trump administration officials like Vice President Mike Pence had actually helped his company by raising awareness of the 5G network and of Huawei's technology.
sentences.zh: （如副总统迈克·彭斯）对其公司的反对，实际上通过提高人们对5G网络和华为技术的认知，帮助了他的公司。

sentences.en: First of all, I would like to thank them because they are great figures.
sentences.zh: 首先，我要感谢他们，因为他们都是大人物。

sentences.en: 5G was not known by common people, but now these great figures are all talking about 5G and we're becoming more influential and getting more contracts.
sentences.zh: 5G原本不为人知，但现在这些大人物都在谈论5G，我们变得更有影响力，也获得了更多合同。

sentences.en: I sense a little bit of sarcasm there.
sentences.zh: 我感觉这里有一点讽刺意味。

sentences.en: Oh, please tell them.
sentences.zh: 哦，请转告他们。

sentences.en: I'm actually thanking them for promoting us.
sentences.zh: 我其实是在感谢他们为我们做宣传。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: A major standoff over humanitarian aid and political power between Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro and opposition leader Juan Guaido
sentences.zh: 委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗与反对派领袖胡安·瓜伊多之间围绕人道主义援助和政治权力的重大对峙，

sentences.en: ended in a smattering of military defections, gunfire, and two deaths over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 在周末以零星的军队叛逃、枪击和两人死亡而告终。

sentences.en: On Saturday, Guaido and his supporters sought to bring a convoy of trucks carrying food into Venezuela from Brazil in a major test of Guaido's standing.
sentences.zh: 周六，瓜伊多及其支持者试图将一车运送食品的卡车从巴西运入委内瑞拉，这是对瓜伊多地位的一次重大考验。

sentences.en: But the trucks were largely blocked by troops loyal to
sentences.zh: 但这些卡车大都遭到效忠于

sentences.en: Maduro, who opened fire on protesters.
sentences.zh: 马杜罗的部队的拦截，他们向抗议者开枪。

sentences.en: Guaido has been recognized as Venezuela's rightful president by more than 50 countries, but has so far failed to remove Maduro from power.
sentences.zh: 瓜伊多已被50多个国家承认是委内瑞拉的正当总统，但迄今未能将马杜罗赶下台。

sentences.en: At one point over the weekend, Maduro defiantly danced with his wife on live television to remind supporters of Guaido that he remains in charge.
sentences.zh: 周末某个时候，马杜罗在电视直播中挑衅地与妻子共舞，以提醒瓜伊多的支持者他依然掌权。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: Well, we will obviously subpoena the report.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们显然会传唤这份报告。

sentences.en: We will bring Bob Mueller in to testify before Congress.
sentences.zh: 我们会请罗伯特·穆勒到国会作证。

sentences.en: We will take it to court if necessary.
sentences.zh: 如有必要，我们会将此事诉诸法庭。

sentences.en: And in the end, I think the department understands they're going to have to make this public.
sentences.zh: 最后，我认为司法部明白他们必须将此公之于众。

sentences.en: In an interview on ABC's This Week on Sunday, the chairman of the House Intelligence Committee, Adam Schiff, said he would take whatever steps
sentences.zh: 众议院情报委员会主席亚当·希夫周日在美国广播公司的《本周》节目中接受采访时表示，他将采取一切

sentences.en: necessary to ensure that the final report from the special counsel's Russia investigation and the evidence underlying becomes public.
sentences.zh: 必要措施，确保特别检察官对俄罗斯调查的最终报告以及相关底层证据公之于众。

sentences.en: If he were to try to withhold, to try to bury any part of this report, that will be his legacy.
sentences.zh: 如果他试图隐瞒、试图掩盖这份报告的任何部分，那将成为他的政治遗产。

sentences.en: And it will be a tarnished legacy.
sentences.zh: 而且这将是不光彩的政治遗产。

sentences.en: So I think there'll be immense pressure not only on the department, but on the attorney general to be forthcoming.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为不仅对司法部，对总检察长来说，都会面临巨大的公开表态压力。

sentences.en: Schiff said he would begin with public pressure on the new attorney general, William Barr, but that he would quickly escalate, if need be, to legal action against the White House.
sentences.zh: 希夫表示，他将从对新任总检察长威廉·巴尔施加公众压力开始，但如果需要，他将迅速升级为对白宫的法律诉讼。

sentences.en: Are you talking about public pressure?
sentences.zh: 你是在说公众压力吗？

sentences.en: Are you prepared to take the administration to court?
sentences.zh: 你准备好将政府告上法庭了吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: We are going to get to the bottom of this.
sentences.zh: 我们要查明真相。

sentences.en: We are going to share this information with the public.
sentences.zh: 我们要与公众分享这些信息。

sentences.en: And if the president is serious about all of his claims of exoneration, then he should welcome the publication of this report.
sentences.zh: 如果总统对他的所有洗白声称是认真的，那么他应该欢迎这份报告的公开发布。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场残酷、混乱、有时又令人兴奋的权力争斗中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》节目中，我将与萨拉·科尼格一起，讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在你获取播客的任何地方收听。
